command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: Owner of the share dialog session moved but docs not updated: design.md D6 says "Controller: `useMeetingShare` owns the dialog session (FR1, FR8–FR10)" and docs/glossary/time-selection.md 'Share dialog' lists "*Code:* `MeetingShareDialog`, `LazyMeetingShareDialog`, `useMeetingShare`". In code, useMeetingShare.ts only holds the open flag, the notice and textSharing; the ticks, share language, rows, reference line, text, destinations and share() are in the new packages/client/src/controller/useMeetingShareDialog.ts (mounted by the new app/AppShellShareDialog.tsx). Neither name appears in docs/ or the change's design.md. .claude/rules/glossary.md: "A change that shifts a term's meaning, owner or Russian name updates the entry in the same change." Update the glossary 'Share dialog'/'Share meeting' Code: entries (and design D6) to name useMeetingShareDialog, or move the session back into useMeetingShare.

packages/client/src/controller/useMeetingShareDialog.ts is 258 lines. design.md D6: "If the file passes 200 lines, the session state moves to `useMeetingShareSession.ts`"; CLAUDE.md: "Files must stay under 200 lines for AI context quality". Only the excluded ids and the language were moved to useMeetingShareSession.ts, leaving the main hook well over 200. Split out further (e.g. text building, dialog rows, pin/language commands).

Dead code in four unit BDD step files: meeting_share_dialog_unit.steps.tsx:42, meeting_share_dialog_language_unit.steps.tsx:39, meeting_share_dialog_preview_unit.steps.tsx:28 and meeting_share_dialog_budget_unit.steps.tsx:28 build unused closures (dialogIsOpen, whenChoosesShareMeeting, ...) and hide them with `void [dialogIsOpen, whenChoosesShareMeeting, closeDialog, choose];`. Remove the unused locals instead of suppressing them; this does not match the surrounding code style.

Over-broad traceability comment: meeting_share_dialog_budget_unit.steps.tsx:1 says `// Verifies FR1, FR2, FR3, FR4, FR5, FR6, FR8, FR9, FR10, FR12, UX5, NFR-P1 of add-meeting-share-dialog.` but its only two scenarios ('A tick builds no formatter', 'Returning to a used language builds no formatter') verify NFR-P1 only. This inflates the grep-based coverage check of task 9.3; limit the comment to NFR-P1.
